tactics: intro α p xs i h
intros α p xs i h
intro α p xs i h <;> induction xs generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.findIdx_cons] <;> split at h <;> simp_all
intro α p xs <;> induction xs with | nil => simp | cons x xs ih => intro i h; cases i <;> simp_all [List.findIdx_cons] <;> split at h <;> simp_all
